source: Original APK IL2CPP offline ARM64 and serialized Unity prefabs, not runtime capture

native.mirror: clockwise=true: target.localRotation identity; clockwise=false: target.localRotation Euler(0,0,PI), flips local X in XZ projection
native.reverse: tryReverse calls createEffect again with updated radius and opposite clockwise flag
native.lifetime: OnExec applies EffectTools.FixEffectTime to event aliveTime; no division by particle speed

export.normalization: CurveSwordEffect.target serialized localRotation is reset to identity as original render callback does; runtime applies the opposite-direction Z=PI rotation. Other authored transforms and particle curves remain unchanged.
limitations: H5 XZ projection is not bit-identical to Unity 3D camera
Unity random stream, custom shader programs and exact particle damping remain existing renderer limits
